# jans_admin_ui_configuration (Data Source)

Data source for retrieving the AdminUI application configuration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `acr_values` (String) ACR values requested by the AdminUI.
- `additional_parameters` (List of Object) Additional authentication parameters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--additional_parameters))
- `allow_smtp_keystore_edit` (Boolean) Whether editing the SMTP keystore is allowed from the AdminUI.
- `auth_server_host` (String) Host of the authorization server.
- `authz_base_url` (String) Base URL of the authorization endpoint.
- `cedarling_log_type` (String) Cedarling log type. Possible values are off and std_out.
- `client_id` (String) Client id used by the AdminUI.
- `end_session_endpoint` (String) End session endpoint.
- `front_channel_logout_url` (String) Front channel logout URL.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `post_logout_redirect_uri` (String) Post logout redirect URI.
- `redirect_url` (String) Redirect URL of the AdminUI.
- `response_type` (String) OAuth response type.
- `scope` (String) Scopes requested by the AdminUI.
- `session_timeout_in_mins` (Number) Session timeout in minutes.

<a id="nestedatt--additional_parameters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `additional_parameters`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)
